item.title: Collision shuts road north of Grantham
item.description: Police are currently attending a collision between a lorry and a car on the A17 between Beckingham and Brant Broughton. They expect the road between Coddington and Fulbeck Heath to be closed for a significant amount of time. Please avoid the area. Incident 249 of today’s date refers.
